## Problem Description
A clear and concise description of the problem or use case you want to address. For example, "I want to be able to..." or "It would be helpful if..."

## Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you would like to see implemented. What should the feature do? How should users interact with it?

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you have considered that might address the same problem.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, examples, or references that might be helpful. Consider including:
- Related issues or discussions
- Relevant use cases or workflows
- Examples from similar tools
- Implementation ideas or technical considerations
